childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Vana pavanoberekwa kuona kwavo kunenge kusina kusimba. Vanenge vakaita se 'mapofu'. Asi kuona kwavo kunozokura mumakore 5 kusvika 8 anotevera, uye kuvandudzika kukuru kunoitika mumwedzi 18 yekutanga yehupenyu. Iyi inguva yakakosha zvikuru.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Panguva iyi, hurongwa hwekuona hwemaziso nehuropi hunofanira kunge huri hwakanaka uye huchikurudzirwa. Iyi ndiyo nguva yakanakisisa yekuona chirwere nekutumira munhu kunorapwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Nei uye sei tichiona chirwere kuti kuona kukure zvakanyanya
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Chero chirwere cheziso kana chehuropi chinononotsa kukura uye chinoderedza kuona kwenguva refu. Ndokusaka zvakakosha kuona nekukurumidza sezvinobvira zvikonzero zvinorapika zvechirwere zvinokanganisa kuona kwakajairika uye kukura kwese.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Izvi zvinogona kuitwa nekubvunza nezvekuona, pamuviri, kuberekwa, chero zvirwere uye kukura kwese
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Wobva waongorora maziso uchiyera kukura kwekuona, wobva waita kuongorora chirwere cheziso nekuita bvunzo ye fundal 'red' reflex uye nekuongorora chikamu chepamberi cheziso
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: Mudumbu, kacheche kanenge kasati kaberekwa kakakomberedzwa nokunzwika kunyoro uye kunodzikama, kusanganisira kurova kwemwoyo waamai vavo nemanzwi nemanzwi zvinobva kunyika iri kunze.
Sezvo pamuviri painosvika nhanho dzekupedzisira, maziso emwana anogona kuvhurika mukati mechibereko.
Nepo havasati vaona mifananidzo kana ruzivo, vanogona kuona shanduko muchiedza.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Mufananidzo wedanho repamuviri wemwana asati azvarwa ari mudumbu
Late pregnancy stage illustration inoratidza kuziva kwechiedza
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: Pakuzvara chiono chakasiyana zvikuru nechomunhu mukuru. Mwana achangozvarwa 'bofu' ane kusaona zvakanaka kweanosvika 6/600. Ivo havaone yakawanda ruvara uye vane yakaderera musiyano sensitivity. Havana stereovision uye maziso avo anogona kuputika nguva nenguva.

Ivo zvakadaro vanozotarisa zvakananga pazviso zviri pedyo zvakanyanya, uye kusvina maziso avo kuvharika kumwenje wakajeka. Chiono chavo kubva zvino chichakura nekukurumidza uye kuita semunhu mukuru pazera remakore masere.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: Mukati memavhiki maviri chiono chakavandudzika zvikuru. Ivo vanogona ikozvino kuona zvimwe, kunyanya kana zvinhu zviri pedyo. Iko hakuna ruvara uye izvo zvavanoona zvakati sandara, nekuti maziso avo haasati agara akatwasuka uye achishanda pamwechete kuti aone zvakadzama.
Dzimwe nguva maziso avo anotsvedza mukati kana kubuda kwenguva pfupi. Uku kunonzi kutswinya. Izvi zvinofanira kumira kuitika nemwedzi mitatu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: Nemwedzi mumwe ruvara rwemavara runotanga kukura. Vachanyanya kufarira zvekuona kunyanya kune zviso. Vanozotangawo kuedza kutevera zvinhu zviri kufamba.
Ivo vanozowedzera kuziva manzwi akajairwa anosanganisira manzwi anozivikanwa semhuri yavo. Uye tanga kubatanidza izvo zvavanonzwa nezvavanoona.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemavhiki maviri nemwedzi mumwe
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Mumwedzi mitatu maziso avo anofanira kugara akatwasuka uye achishanda pamwechete kugadzira 3D kuona. Aya maonero matsva akadzama anovabatsira kusvika kune zvinhu nemazvo. Vachakwanisa kutevera zvinhu zviri kufamba nekukurumidza asi zvakaoma kushandura kugadzirisa kubva kune chimwe chiso kana chinhu kuenda kune chimwe nekukurumidza.
Vanoda kutarisa chinhu chimwe chete panguva. Vanogonawo kutanga kuita manzwi avo ekutanga ane revo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemwedzi mumwe kusvika mitatu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Mucheche ane chiono chinowanzoita chiono anozonakidzwa nekuona kapu yekunwira kana chipunu uye anogona kugara achigadzirisa nekutevera chiso ari chinhambwe chemamita 1-2 pamwe nekukwanisa kusiyanisa zviso zvakajairwa neasina kujaira nezviso zvavo zvese nemanzwi.
Vanogonawo kutanga kuona zvinhu zviri kure. Vachisundwa neshungu dzokuda kuziva, vanotanga kunanavira zvinhu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: Pamakore matanhatu kusvika kumwedzi gumi nemiviri yezera kuona kwekuona kuri kuwedzera uye kwakapoteredza 6/36. Nhambwe inotariswa zviso nekuzivikanwa yakawedzera kusvika pamamita maviri. Zvese zvinhu zvekuona zviri kuvandudzwa nekunyatsosvika uye kubata.

Pazera rino ivo vari kuwedzera kufarira mifananidzo mumabhuku uye paterevhizheni, kunyangwe zvinhu chaizvo zviri kunyanya kuita zvichivakurudzira kukambaira uye kutenderedza zuva ravo rekuzvarwa, famba uchienda kune zvinhu zvinofarirwa. Kubhuya kwavo kuri kukura, uye manzwi anozova mazwi ekutanga pazera rino zvakare.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Pakazosvika mwedzi gumi nemisere, kuona kunenge kwave munhu mukuru sekuti kuchiri kubvondoka pakunyatsoona kunosvika 6/18. Vachakwanisa kuziva zita ravo uye kushandisa mamwe mazwi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemwedzi gumi nemiviri negumi nemisere
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Mushure memwedzi 18 yezera kuona kuchiri kuda makore akawanda kuti akure. Normal acuity yevakuru kuona ichaumbwa nezera re8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemwedzi gumi nemisere nemakore masere
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Mushure mezera re8 iyo yekuona system inogona kusanatsiridza zvakanaka kurapwa senge cataract kuvhiyiwa. Kuzivikanwa kwechirwere uye kuendeswa kunorapwa kunoitwa zviri nani pakutanga kwehupenyu sezvinobvira.

Zvinogona kuonekwa kuti kukura kukuru kunoitika pakati pekuzvarwa nemwedzi gumi nemisere yezera uye inoenderera zvishoma nezvishoma muhudiki hwose. Munguva iyi zvakakosha kuti mwana ave neutano hwakanaka nehurwere husina hurongwa hwekuona uye hupihwe nharaunda inokurudzira uye inovaka dzidzo.
Kukurumidza kuzivikanwa kwechirwere nekuendeswa kunorapwa kwakakosha kubatsira kukwidziridza zvese zvekuona uye kukura kwese.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_image: Mushure memakore masere mufananidzo wekukura kwekuona

i18nLiteral.A white pupil present from birth, with p: Mudzidzi muchena aripo kubva pakuzvarwa, asina kuona zvakanaka, anokwana congenital cataract.
i18nLiteral.Gradual, painless worsening vision over: Kuona zvishoma nezvishoma, kusingarwadzi kunowedzera kwemwedzi mumunhu mukuru akura anokwana cataract.
i18nLiteral.A white pupil in a young child with redu: Mudzidzi muchena mumwana mudiki ane kuderedzwa kwekuona kubata ane chekuita neretinoblastoma.
i18nLiteral.Acute onset, pink eye, yellow discharge: Acute kutanga, ziso repingi, kubuda kweyero uye zviratidzo zvinowedzera zvinokwana conjunctivitis yakaoma.
i18nLiteral.Long-term irritation with painful gritty: Kushatirwa kwenguva refu nekunzwa kunorwadza, ziso dzvuku uye kusaona zvakanaka zvinokwana trichiasis ine mavanga.
i18nLiteral.Corneal trauma followed by increasing pa: Corneal trauma inoteverwa nekuwedzera kurwadziwa, kutsvuka uye kurasikirwa kwekuona kunoratidza corneal ulcer.
i18nLiteral.Unilateral gritty watery eye with a rece: Unilateral gritty watery ziso rine chironda chemuromo chichangobva kubuda chinokodzera herpes simplex keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia with watery eye and blurred: Photophobia ine ziso rine mvura uye kusaona kwakasviba inoratidza anterior uveitis.
i18nLiteral.Slowly progressive irritation and blur i: Zvishoma nezvishoma kushatirwa kunofambira mberi uye kusajeka mumunhu akwegura, kazhinji ziso rimwe, rinokwana pterygium.
i18nLiteral.Foreign body exposure (working under a c: Kuratidzwa kwemuviri wekunze (kushanda pasi pemota) uine gritty, kuwedzera zviratidzo zvinoratidza kuchengetedzwa kwekunze kwemuviri nekutanga kutapukirwa.
i18nLiteral.Blunt trauma with red eye and very poor: Kukuvara kwakashata neziso dzvuku uye kusaona kwakashata kunoratidza hyphaema.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with pain, red eye and wors: Kukuvara kwetsvimbo nekurwadziwa, ziso dzvuku uye kuwedzera kwekuona zvinogona kuratidza inopinda corneal laceration.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with very poor vision and r: Kukuvara kwetsvimbo nekusaona zvakanaka uye ziso dzvuku zvinogona kuratidza kukuvara kwemukati kunokonzera kushungurudzika kwecataract.
i18nLiteral.Please ask at least one question before: Ndapota bvunza mubvunzo mumwe chete usati watumira.
i18nLiteral.You have used both attempts. Moving to t: Washandisa zvose kuedza. Kuenda kune inotevera kesi.
i18nLiteral.Slow, painless vision loss over months t: Kunonoka, kusingarwadze kurasikirwa kwekuona kwemwedzi kusvika kumakore uine ziso jena uye nenjodzi huru ine mamiriro emuAfrica, nhoroondo yemhuri, makore anopfuura makumi mana uye kupfupika kuona kunoenderana POAG.
i18nLiteral.Fast vision loss over hours to days with: Kurasika kwekuona nekukurumidza kwemaawa kusvika kumazuva neziso dzvuku rinorwadza uye halos yakatenderedza mwenje ine njodzi yakanyanya neAsia kumashure, kuchembera uye cataract inokodzera ACAG.
i18nLiteral.My vision is not as good as it used to b: Chiono changu hachina kumira zvakanaka sezvachaive chiri. Zvave kuchinja zvishoma nezvishoma.
i18nLiteral.It started a long time ago, maybe months: Zvakatanga kare kare, zvichida mwedzi kusvika makore.
i18nLiteral.It came on slowly. There was no injury o: Yakauya zvishoma nezvishoma. Pakanga pasina kukuvara kana chiitiko chakaerekana.
Inonzwa kunge maziso ese ari kubatwa.
i18nLiteral.No redness and no discharge. The eye loo: Hapana kutsvuka uye hapana kubuda. Ziso rinoita jena.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the vision has been getting worse,: Hungu, chiono chacho chave chichiwedzera kuipa, asi zvishoma nezvishoma.
Zviri kuwedzera kuipa zvishoma nezvishoma nekufamba kwenguva.
i18nLiteral.I am short sighted and I wear glasses fo: Ndiri kuona zvishoma uye ndinopfeka magirazi kure. Baba vangu vaiva neglaucoma. Ndapfuura makore makumi mana.
i18nLiteral.My vision suddenly became blurry and my: Chiono changu chakaerekana chatsvuka uye ziso rangu rorwadza zvikuru.
i18nLiteral.It started suddenly, within the last few: Zvakatanga kamwe kamwe, mukati memaawa mashoma apfuura.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the vision got worse quickly over h: Hungu, chiono chacho chakawedzera kuipa nokukurumidza mumaawa akawanda.
i18nLiteral.I see halos around lights. I have had a: Ndinoona halos yakatenderedza mwenje. Ndakamborwiswa zvakadaro zvisati zvaenda. Ndiri kuona kwenguva refu uye ndinoda magirazi ekuona pedyo. Ndakaudzwa kuti ndine ziso.
i18nLiteral.Clinical signs are consistent with this: Zviratidzo zvekiriniki zvinowirirana neiyi kesi label.
i18nLiteral.Good vision and long outdoor work make t: Kuona kwakanaka uye basa refu rekunze rinoita kuti kuongororwa uku kuwedzere.
i18nLiteral.Gritty painful eye after metal work sugg: Ziso rinorwadza rinorwadza mushure mekushanda kwesimbi rinoratidza corneal yekunze muviri.
i18nLiteral.Light sensitivity and blurred vision sug: Kunzwa kwechiedza uye kusaona kwakasviba zvinoratidza kuti hutachiona hwekutanga huri kutanga.
i18nLiteral.Listen to what the patient says and tap: Teerera kune izvo murwere anotaura uye tora mufananidzo unonyatsoenderana nechirwere.
i18nLiteral.Long-term gritty pain with blurry vision: Kurwadziwa kwenguva refu kwegomarara nekuona kwakajeka kunoratidza kukuvara kusingaperi kwepasi.
i18nLiteral.Newborn age and maternal STI history sup: Makore achangozvarwa uye nhoroondo yenjovhera yaamai inotsigira gonococcal/chlamydial conjunctivitis.
i18nLiteral.No red eye or discharge suggests catarac: Hapana ziso dzvuku kana kubuda kunoratidza cataract, kwete chirwere cheziso.
i18nLiteral.One painful light-sensitive eye with wat: Rimwe ziso rinorwadza rinonzwa chiedza rine kutsvuka kwemvura rinoratidza keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Painful red eye with fast decline suppor: Ziso dzvuku rinorwadza nekuderera kwekukurumidza rinotsigira kushungurudza cataract.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia, pain, and blurred vision in: Photophobia, kurwadziwa, uye kusaona muziso mune rimwe ziso zvinoratidza uveitis.
i18nLiteral.Poor visual attention supports this diag: Kusatarisisa kwekuona kunotsigira kuongororwa uku uye kunoda kutumirwa nekukurumidza.
i18nLiteral.Recent painful lip sores support herpes: Zvironda zvinorwadza zvemuromo zvinotsigira herpes simplex keratitis.
i18nLiteral.Repeated similar episodes support anteri: Zvikamu zvakadzokororwa zvakafanana zvinotsigira anterior uveitis.
i18nLiteral.Severe pain and red eye after a scratch: Kurwadza kwakanyanya uye ziso rakatsvuka mushure mekukwenya kubva mugwenzi zvinoratidza corneal ulcer.
i18nLiteral.Severe vision loss after stick trauma su: Kurasikirwa kwekuona kwakanyanya mushure mekukuvadzwa kwetsvimbo kunoratidza kukuvara kweziso rinopinda.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with worsening pain and blu: Kukuvara kwetsvimbo nekurwadziwa kuri kuwedzera uye kusviba zvinoratidza kukuvara kwepasirese.
i18nLiteral.Sudden vision loss after blunt trauma is: Kurasika kwekuona kamwe kamwe mushure mekurwadziswa kwakanyanya kunowanzoitika kune traumatic hyphaema.
i18nLiteral.Thick yellow discharge and pink eyes sug: Kubuda kweyero yakakora uye maziso epingi anoratidza bacterial conjunctivitis.
i18nLiteral.This pattern fits penetrating corneal la: Iyi pateni inokodzera inopinda corneal laceration neiris prolapse.
i18nLiteral.This pattern fits trachomatous trichiasi: Iyi pateni inokodzera trachomatous trichiasis ine cornea scarring.
i18nLiteral.This sticky red-eye pattern can be due t: Iyi patani yeziso dzvuku inonamira inogona kukonzerwa negonococcal/chlamydial infection.
i18nLiteral.Vision became worse slowly over many mon: Kuona kwakawedzera zvishoma nezvishoma kwemwedzi yakawanda, pasina kurwadziwa.
i18nLiteral.A painful red watering eye with shadow v: Ziso dzvuku rinonwisa mvura rinorwadza nekuona kwemumvuri rinotsigira kuongororwa uku.
i18nLiteral.A slow-growing pink patch with mild grit: Pechi yepingi inokura zvishoma nezvishoma ine mild grit sensation inoratidza pterygium.
i18nLiteral.A white pupil in a baby is a key danger: Mudzidzi muchena mucheche chiratidzo chikuru chenjodzi ye retinoblastoma.
i18nLiteral.Discharge and very poor vision support b: Kubuda uye kusaona kwakanyanya kunotsigira hutachiona / fungal corneal hutachiona.
